skill.description: When the user wants to find, qualify, and build a list of prospects to reach out to — across B2B SaaS, general B2B, or local small businesses. Also use when the user mentions "prospecting," "build a prospect list," "find prospects," "find leads," "lead gen list," "find SaaS companies that," "find B2B companies," "find local businesses," "ICP-fit accounts," "who should we go after," "outbound list," "target account list," "find clients near me," "businesses without websites," "prospect research," "qualified leads," "find my first customers," "early adopters," "design partners," "beta users," or "who has this problem." Use this for the list-building and qualification phase. For writing the outbound copy after the list is built, see cold-email. For deep competitive research on specific accounts, see competitor-profiling.
skill.summary: Build verified prospect lists for SaaS, B2B, local businesses, and early demand discovery.

content.value_statement: Unfocused lead research produces stale contacts and weak matches. This skill defines an ICP, verifies evidence, scores prospects, and applies outreach compliance safeguards.
actual_capabilities: Selects workflows for SaaS, general B2B, local business, or demand-signal prospecting.
Defines an ideal customer profile with firmographic, technographic, buying-signal, and exclusion criteria.
Recommends appropriate public, licensed, and browser-assisted research sources.
Scores candidates using branch-specific qualification and confidence rules.
Produces cited lead tables, CSV-ready columns, or demand-signal evidence reports.
Applies email validation, source lineage, privacy, and platform compliance checks.
limitations: Requires access to external data providers or manual browser research for current prospect information.
Cannot guarantee that provider records, funding data, technology signals, or contact details are current.
Does not replace legal advice for GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL, or platform terms.
Does not send outreach or bypass logins, CAPTCHAs, paywalls, or anti-bot controls.

use_cases.title: Prioritize SaaS accounts
use_cases.description: Build a verified account list using funding, technology, hiring, and decision-maker signals.

use_cases.title: Find local service prospects
use_cases.description: Research active nearby businesses and classify their website presence without bulk platform scraping.

use_cases.title: Discover first customers
use_cases.description: Find recent public problem signals, score demand fit, and prepare a manual validation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Define my prospect profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Define an ICP for [product] sold to [market]. Ask for missing geography, company size, buying signals, decision-makers, and disqualifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Build a focused lead list
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a list of [count] [SaaS/B2B/local] prospects matching [criteria]. Use my available tools: [tools]. Cite sources and show confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Qualify an existing list
prompt_templates.prompt: Qualify these prospects against [ICP]. Verify firmographic fit, recent buying signals, contact status, source dates, duplicates, and disqualifiers. Rank the strongest targets.

prompt_templates.title: Run demand-signal discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [count] potential first customers for [product]. Use recent public professional signals, cite original sources, score demand fit, and draft manual outreach openers.

output_examples.input: Find 15 Austin fitness studios that may need a better website.
output: A lead table with business, area, website status, public contact channel, source, confidence, and qualification reason.
Three priority targets supported by recent activity and verified website gaps.
Open questions for records that need manual confirmation.

output_examples.input: Find recent Series B companies using HubSpot and hiring RevOps leaders.
output: A ranked SaaS account list with funding dates, technology evidence, hiring signals, decision-makers, and source dates.
Confidence labels that separate verified facts from incomplete provider data.
A short list of top outreach targets with evidence-based timing reasons.

output_examples.input: Find ten potential design partners experiencing failed-payment follow-up problems.
output: An evidence report linking each prospect to a recent public professional problem signal.
Demand-fit scores covering pain, product fit, timing, reachability, and evidence quality.
A seven-day manual validation plan with source-based outreach drafts.

best_practices: Define pass, fail, and disqualification criteria before collecting candidates.
Cross-check important claims and record every source URL with its verification date.
Validate email deliverability and confirm lawful use before handing contacts to outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not bulk scrape LinkedIn, Google Maps, Yelp, gated communities, or protected platforms.
Do not label a prospect as interested without a cited and current demand signal.
Do not use leaked data, private contact details, or sensitive personal traits for targeting.

faq.question: Which prospecting motions are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports SaaS, general B2B, local business, and early-stage demand-signal discovery.

faq.question: Can it find current prospects without paid tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide manual research using public websites, search, directories, and business pages, but results will take longer.

faq.question: Does it send cold email?
faq.answer: No. It builds and qualifies lists, validates contact readiness, and can draft demand-signal openers for manual review.

faq.question: How does it judge confidence?
faq.answer: High confidence needs two independent sources or an official page. Medium uses one credible source, while low marks unresolved evidence.

faq.question: Does it support GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance?
faq.answer: It provides source-lineage and lawful-use checks, but users must obtain legal advice for their jurisdiction and outreach program.

faq.question: Can it scrape LinkedIn or Google Maps?
faq.answer: No. It requires manual, browser-assisted discovery and prohibits bulk extraction or bypassing platform protections.
